Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2021 14:20:38 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net: broadcom: bcm4908_enet: enable RX after processing
 packets
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

When receiving a lot of packets hardware may run out of free
descriptiors and stop RX ring. Enable it every time after handling
received packets.

Fixes: 4feffeadbcb2 ("net: broadcom: bcm4908enet: add BCM4908 controller driver")
Signed-off-by: Rafał Miłecki <rafal@milecki.pl>
Acked-by: Florian Fainelli <f.fainelli@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210226132038.29849-1-zajec5@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcm4908_enet.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcm4908_enet.c
index 0b70e9e0ddad..98cf82dea3e4 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcm4908_enet.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcm4908_enet.c
@@ -592,6 +592,9 @@ static int bcm4908_enet_poll(struct napi_struct *napi, int weight)
 		bcm4908_enet_intrs_on(enet);
 	}
 
+	/* Hardware could disable ring if it run out of descriptors */
+	bcm4908_enet_dma_rx_ring_enable(enet, &enet->rx_ring);
+
 	return handled;
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bcm4908_enet.c`**
   - A new line of code was added in the `bcm4908_enet_poll` function to enable the RX (receive) ring after processing received packets. This is done by calling the function `bcm4908_enet_dma_rx_ring_enable(enet, &enet->rx_ring);`.
   - The comment above the new line explains that the hardware could disable the RX ring if it runs out of descriptors, indicating the purpose of this modification.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a bug related to the RX ring being disabled when the hardware runs out of free descriptors while receiving a large number of packets. By enabling the RX ring after handling packets, the patch ensures that the system can continue to receive packets without interruption.
- This change is a direct fix for the issue introduced in a previous commit (identified by the Fixes tag), which added the BCM4908 controller driver. The new code enhances the functionality of the driver by ensuring that it can handle high packet loads more effectively.

This indicates that if the RX ring runs out of free descriptors, it will not be re-enabled, leading to the bug described.
